name: Pantry crate
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE original, polished logo concept for Japita, a restaurant supplier and purchasing advisor app. This is one of ten deliberately different design directions, not a recolor of an existing logo.
App visual style: Ajitama; bold friendly Japanese-inspired typography, flat food illustrations, thick warm-charcoal outlines, simplified geometric silhouettes, rounded but substantial forms, generous negative space, no fussy details. Exact palette: charcoal #1E1B18 as main ink; yolk yellow #F4BC2B as primary accent; chili red #E0482B as occasional small secondary accent. Must be legible both on white and on a yolk-yellow app header. Use one or two accent areas maximum.
Text (verbatim): "Japita". Spell J-a-p-i-t-a exactly, once. No other text, slogans, numbers, mockup labels or captions.
Create a centered generous landscape logo lockup occupying most of the canvas width, with balanced transparent padding. Clean vector-like raster artwork with genuine alpha transparency, crisp edges, limited flat colors, graphic-design quality, optical balance and strong small-size readability. No gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, photography, fake paper, decorative frames, watermarks, dollar/currency signs, chef hats or shopping carts. Do not mimic an existing brand.
Specific direction: A simple open grocery supply crate holding three abstract ingredients: one leaf, one bottle neck and one rounded produce shape. A confident compact emblem, functional and warm. Horizontal lockup, emblem left and wordmark right. Bold friendly Japanese-grotesk lettering.
